## 代码结构（与文档一致）

- **`apps/app`**：主 Web 应用（Vite + React），依赖 `@tap/canvas`、`@tap/video-editor`、`@tap/image-designer` 等 workspace 包。  
- **`apps/server`**：基于 **Hono** 的 BFF/API（README 含 Sentry 说明）。  
- **`apps/storybook`**：组件文档与交互。  
- **`packages/`**：单体功能包，例如 **canvas**（ReactFlow 节点画布）、**video-editor**、**image-designer**（Fabric.js）、**chat**、**tap-models**、**auth**、**billing**、**endpoints**、**shared**、**shadcn** 等。

技术栈在根 README 里写得很清楚：React 18、TypeScript、Vite 7、Turbo、Tailwind 4、Zustand、Alova、Biome、pnpm monorepo。

---

## 与「画布 / 图像」相关的核心代码线索

- **`packages/canvas`**：`README.md` 描述多模态节点、AI 集成、节点类型等；**RFC.35** 专门讲节点系统、持久化边界、`NodeType` 等，是理解画布数据模型的首选文档。  
- **`packages/canvas/src/core/`**：节点类型、创意类图像节点等（例如 `nodes/creative/image`）。  
- **`packages/chat`**：对话与部分生成类 API 类型（如 `Touch2Edit`、`GenerateWorld` 等参数在 `api/types` 里）。  

若你接下来要做的是 **面部/人像编辑**，需要在仓库里再按功能名（例如 inpaint、portrait、face）做定向搜索；当前从文档标题看，项目是通用 **TapNow 创意平台**，而不是单独的 face 小程序。

generatedImages[selectedResultIndex] || generatedImages[0]\n        : src;\n\n    return (\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col h-full gap-3\">\n        {/* Main preview */}\n        <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-black/20 min-h-0\">\n          <img\n            src={displaySrc}\n            alt={title || \"Preview\"}\n            className=\"max-w-full max-h-full object-contain rounded-lg\"\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Title */}\n        {title && (\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center truncate\">\n            {title}\n          </p>\n        )}\n\n        {/* Generated results thumbnails */}\n        {(generatedImages.length > 0 || isGenerating) && (\n          <div className=\"space-y-1.5\">\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">\n              {t(\"faceEdit.results\")} ({generatedImages.length})\n            </p>\n            <div className=\"flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1\">\n              {isGenerating && (\n                <div className=\"w-16 h-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-border flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30\">\n                  <Loader2 className=\"w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground\" />\n                </div>\n              )}\n              {generatedImages.map((img, idx) => (\n                <button\n                  key={idx}\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => onSelectResult(idx)}\n                  className={cn(\n                    \"w-16 h-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded-md overflow-hidden border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer\",\n                    idx === selectedResultIndex\n                      ? \"border-primary ring-1 ring-primary/30\"\n                      : \"border-transparent hover:border-border\",\n                  )}\n                >\n                  <img\n                    src={img}\n                    alt={`Result ${idx + 1}`}\n                    className=\"w-full h-full object-cover\"\n                  />\n                </button>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    );\n  },\n);\n\nFaceEditPreview.displayName = \"FaceEditPreview\";\n"
}

根据计划，人物资产编辑功能的完整数据流已经打通。以下是各环节的状态：

| 组件/文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `TemplateCard.tsx` | 三点下拉菜单（重命名/编辑/删除）已实现，使用 `@tap/shadcn` 的 `DropdownMenu` |
| `type.ts` | `onItemEdit?: (item: TemplateItem) => void` 已声明 |
| `TemplateGallery.tsx` | 已透传 `onItemEdit`，在 `showContextMenu` 条件下传给 `TemplateCard` |
| `media-space-store.ts` | 完整的 Face Edit 状态：`faceEditOpen`、`faceEditAssetItem`、`openFaceEdit`、`closeFaceEdit`，以及 `useFaceEdit`/`useFaceEditActions` selector hooks |
| `AssetPanel.tsx` | `handleAssetEdit` 调用 `openFaceEdit(item)` 并关闭 popover |
| `MediaSpaceHolder.tsx` | `<FaceEditOverlay />` 已挂载 |

### 本次修复的文件

1. **`FaceEditControls.tsx`** — 接口改为 `referenceImageSrc` + `onGenerated(string[])` + `onGeneratingChange(boolean)`，与 Overlay 完全对齐。内部使用 `useImageGeneration()` 直接调用 `@tap/tap-models` 生成服务，不依赖画布节点。

2. **`FaceEditPreview.tsx`** — 支持多张生成结果缩略图，带选择高亮。主预览区自动切换为选中的生成结果或原图。

3. **`FaceEditOverlay.tsx`** — 已确认磁盘版本包含完整功能：
   - "保存到资产"：更新 `preview_image` 和 `template_data.nodes[].data.src`
   - "添加到画布"：通过 `createFactory` 创建 IMAGE 节点并 `fitView`
   - 正确的 props 透传给子组件

4. **i18n** — `zh_CN/canvas.json` 和 `en_US/canvas.json` 补充了 `faceEdit.updateAsset` 和 `faceEdit.results`。

### 完整数据流

```
用户点击资产卡三点菜单 → "编辑"
  → AssetPanel.handleAssetEdit(item)
    → openFaceEdit(item) [store]
      → faceEditOpen = true
        → MediaSpaceHolder 渲染 <FaceEditOverlay />
          → FaceEditPreview (预览原图 + 生成结果)
          → FaceEditControls (Prompt + 参考图 + 模型 + 比例 + 生成按钮)
            → useImageGeneration().send() [tap-models]
              → onGenerated([urls]) → 更新预览
          → "保存到资产" → canvasAssetApis.updateCanvasTemplate()
          → "添加到画布" → createFactory(IMAGE) + setNodes()
```

Now I have a thorough understanding of the codebase. Let me summarize the problem and create a plan.

**Current behavior:**
1. `FaceEditOverlay` uses local `useState` for `generatedImages` - not persisted in store
2. `handleClose` clears all local state (`setGeneratedImages([])`) and calls `close()` which sets `faceEditAssetItem: null`
3. `handleAddToCanvas` adds the selected image to the main canvas, then calls `handleClose()` which exits the face edit overlay
4. `handleSaveToAsset` also calls `handleClose()` after saving


5. The core issue is that generated images live only in component state, so they disappear when the overlay closes and can't be recovered when reopening the same asset

The fix involves persisting generated images to the Zustand store keyed by asset ID, keeping the overlay open after adding to canvas, and only clearing generations when explicitly requested. I'll also add per-image utilities like fullscreen viewing, duplication, and downloading.

The user wants to add a "主体" (subject) feature to the face editor. Looking at the screenshot and the current code:

Current flow:
1. User opens face edit from asset panel (AssetPanel → openFaceEdit(item))
2. The face edit overlay shows the original image and controls
3. User can upload a reference image, write a prompt, select model and aspect ratio
4. Generate results are shown as thumbnails below

What the user wants:
- A way to clearly see which image is the current "主体" (subject/base image) being edited


- The ability to switch between different base images for editing

Looking at the layout, the left side has the main preview with generated results below, while the right side handles the reference image, prompt, model selection, and generation. The "主体" should be distinct from the "参考图" (reference image) — it's the actual base image being edited, which currently comes from `assetItem.raw.preview_image || assetItem.src`.

To make this switchable, I'd extract all available image nodes from the template's `template_data.nodes` when opening the editor, then display them in a selector above the reference image section so users can choose which base image to work with. for editing
4. Also allow the user to use generated results as new subjects

Let me think about another approach:
- The "主体" could also mean different assets/templates in the asset panel. The user might want to switch between different assets/templates while keeping the face edit panel open.

Looking at the screenshot again:
- The main image shows a woman in traditional Chinese style
- Title is "古风" (meaning this is the template/asset name)
- Generated results at the bottom show 4 variants

I think the most useful interpretation is:
1. Show clearly which image (asset) is the current subject being edited
2. Allow switching between different available images from the asset panel, or perhaps from generated results as subjects

Let me design a practical approach:

**Option A: Subject from template nodes**
- Extract images from the current template's nodes
- Show them as switchable subjects

**Option B: Subject from multiple assets**
- Keep a list of recently opened assets
- Allow switching between them

**Option C: Subject as explicit concept**
- Add a "主体" section showing the current base image prominently
- Allow generated results to become the new subject
- Allow uploading a new subject image

I think Option C combined with the ability to pick from the current template's nodes is most practical.

Re-reading the user's request more carefully: they want users to clearly see which image is the current editing subject and be able to freely switch between them. The most straightforward solution is adding a "主体" section at the top of the right panel that displays the current base image, with the ability to switch sources from generated results, template nodes, or uploaded images.

For implementation, I'd maintain a `subjectSrc` state in the overlay component that tracks the current subject—initially the original image but switchable to any generated result or new upload. The controls panel would display this with a thumbnail and switching UI, while the preview shows the indicator.

外环选色相（Hue），内部方块/三角选饱和度和明度\n2. **分类预设色板** - 按场景分组的常用颜色（发色、唇色、眼影、腮红等）\n3. **颜色信息区** - 显示选中颜色的色块、中文名称、HEX 值\n4. **取色器（可选）** - 利用浏览器 EyeDropper API 从预览图中取色\n5. **插入按钮** - 将选中颜色的中文名称插入到 Prompt 文本框\n\n### 技术方案\n\n**色轮组件**：新建自定义 Canvas 色轮组件 `ColorWheel`，绘制外圈 Hue 环 + 内部饱和度/明度选择区域。不引入额外依赖，使用 Canvas API 直接绘制（项目已有 `fabric` 依赖，对 Canvas 操作有支持基础）。也可以考虑使用 `@uiw/react-color-wheel` 轻量库，但自绘更符合截图中 Procreate 风格。\n\n**颜色名称映射**：建立一个中文颜色名称映射表，将 HSL/HEX 范围映射为人类可读的中文颜色名。例如：\n- `#8B0000` -> \"暗红色\"\n- `#D2691E` -> \"巧克力色\"  \n- `#FFD700` -> \"金色\"\n- `#1A1A2E` -> \"深蓝黑\"\n\n按使用场景提供语义化描述，如发色场景自动补充\"发色\"后缀。\n\n**EyeDropper 取色**：使用浏览器原生 `EyeDropper API`（Chrome 95+），允许用户直接从屏幕/预览图上吸取颜色。不支持的浏览器隐藏该按钮。\n\n### 文件变更\n\n#### 新增文件\n\n- **`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/ColorWheel.tsx`**\n  - 自定义色轮组件，Canvas 绘制 Hue 环 + 内部 SV 选择区\n  - Props: `value: string`（HEX）, `onChange: (hex: string) => void`, `size?: number`\n\n- **`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditColorTool.tsx`**\n  - 色彩工具主面板，组合色轮、预设色板、颜色信息、插入按钮\n  - Props: `onInsertColor: (colorName: string) => void`\n  - 使用 `@tap/shadcn` 的 `Popover` 组件作为容器\n\n- **`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/color-presets.ts`**\n  - 预设颜色数据：分类色板定义（发色、唇色、眼影、腮红、肤色等）\n  - 中文颜色名称映射函数 `getColorName(hex: string): string`\n  - HEX/HSL 工具函数\n\n#### 修改文件\n\n- **[FaceEditControls.tsx](packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditControls.tsx)**\n  - 在 Prompt `Textarea` 旁添加色彩工具触发按钮（小色轮图标）\n  - 实现 `handleInsertColor` 回调：将颜色名称追加到当前 prompt 文本中\n  - 位置：在第 514-529 行的 Prompt 区域，label 行右侧添加按钮\n\n- **[index.ts](packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/index.ts)**\n  - 导出新增的 `FaceEditColorTool` 组件\n\n- **[locales/zh_CN/canvas.json](locales/zh_CN/canvas.json)** 和 **[locales/en_US/canvas.json](locales/en_US/canvas.json)**\n  - 在 `faceEdit` 段新增色彩工具相关文案：\n    - `colorTool` / \"色彩工具\" / \"Color Tool\"\n    - `insertColor` / \"插入颜色\" / \"Insert Color\"\n    - `presetHair` / \"发色\" / \"Hair Color\"\n    - `presetLip` / \"唇色\" / \"Lip Color\"\n    - `presetEyeshadow` / \"眼影\" / \"Eye Shadow\"\n    - `presetBlush` / \"腮红\" / \"Blush\"\n    - `pickFromImage` / \"从图片取色\" / \"Pick from Image\"\n    - `recentColors` / \"最近使用\" / \"Recent Colors\"\n\n### UI 布局示意\n\n色彩工具 Popover 面板布局（参考用户提供的 Procreate 截图风格）：\n\n``​`\n+----------------------------------+\n|  [色轮 - Hue环 + SV区域]        |\n|         (180x180)                |\n+----------------------------------+\n|  发色  [色块] [色块] [色块] ...  |\n|  唇色  [色块] [色块] [色块] ...  |\n|  眼影  [色块] [色块] [色块] ...  |\n+----------------------------------+\n|  最近使用  [色块] [色块] ...     |\n+----------------------------------+\n|  [色块预览] 暗红色  #8B0000      |\n|            [🔍取色] [✓ 插入]     |\n+----------------------------------+\n``​`\n\n面板宽度约 260px，与右侧控制栏（280px）匹配。Popover 从 Prompt label 旁的按钮弹出，方向为 `side=\"left\"`，确保不遮挡 Prompt 输入区。\n\n### 插入逻辑\n\n当用户选择颜色并点击\"插入\"时：\n- 若 Prompt 为空 -> 插入 `\"将人物的发色改为暗红色\"`（带上下文模板）\n- 若 Prompt 已有内容 -> 在光标位置插入颜色名称，如 `\"暗红色\"`\n- 支持预设模板快捷操作：用户先选场景（发色/唇色），再选颜色，自动生成完整描述语句\n",

### 👤 用户

> 只输入这个颜色的名称模型能准确还原出这个颜色吗？

### 🤖 Agent

这是一个非常关键的问题。确实，仅靠颜色名称（如"暗红色"）是不够精准的 — AI 模型对颜色名称的理解是模糊的，"暗红色"在不同人和不同模型的理解中可能差异很大。

让我重新思考一下更可靠的方案。

The user raises a very good question - they're asking whether just inserting a color name (like "暗红色") into the prompt would allow the AI model to accurately reproduce that exact color. This is a valid concern because:

1. Color names are subjective and ambiguous - "暗红色" could mean many different shades
2. AI models interpret color names loosely, not as exact hex values
3. The whole point of adding a color tool is to improve precision, but if we only insert a name, we might not achieve much improvement

This means the plan needs to be reconsidered. 

So I'm thinking through better approaches - we could embed the hex code directly in the prompt alongside the color name, generate an actual color swatch image as a visual reference for the model, or combine both the textual description and a reference image to give the model multiple ways to understand the exact color we want.

The most effective solution would be generating a color swatch image and uploading it as a reference alongside a descriptive prompt - since the face edit panel already supports reference images, we could automatically create and upload a swatch whenever the user selects a color, giving the model both visual and textual information to work with. I should propose this approach to the user.

id: export-and-polish\n    content: 更新 index.ts 导出，检查样式适配暗色主题，确保 Popover 层级和定位正确\n    status: pending\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# 人物编辑色彩辅助工具\n\n## 核心问题\n\n单纯的颜色名称（如\"暗红色\"）无法让 AI 模型精准还原目标颜色 -- 同样的名称在不同语境中含义差异很大。\n\n**解决方案：色块参考图 + 描述性 Prompt 双通道**\n\n用户选色后，系统同时做两件事：\n1. 用 Canvas 生成一张纯色色块图，自动设为**参考图（Reference Image）**，给模型提供精确的视觉参考\n2. 在 Prompt 中插入**多维度颜色描述**（中文名 + HEX + 类比描述），给模型提供语义参考\n\n两条通道互补，最大化颜色还原精度。\n\n## 交互流程\n\n``​`mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    A[\"用户点击色彩工具按钮\"] --> B[\"弹出色彩面板\"]\n    B --> C{\"选色方式\"}\n    C --> D[\"色轮自由选色\"]\n    C --> E[\"预设色板选色\"]\n    C --> F[\"EyeDropper 取色\"]\n    D --> G[\"选择应用场景：发色/唇色/眼影...\"]\n    E --> G\n    F --> G\n    G --> H[\"点击应用按钮\"]\n    H --> I[\"Canvas 生成纯色色块图\"]\n    H --> J[\"生成描述性 Prompt 文本\"]\n    I --> K[\"自动设为参考图 Reference Image\"]\n    J --> L[\"插入到 Prompt 输入框\"]\n    K --> M[\"用户点击生成\"]\n    L --> M\n    M --> N[\"模型同时获得视觉+文字两层颜色参考\"]\n``​`\n\n## 技术方案\n\n### 1. 色块参考图生成\n\n在 `color-presets.ts` 中提供 `generateColorSwatch(hex: string): Blob` 工具函数：\n- 使用 offscreen Canvas（256x256）填充纯色\n- 可选：在色块上叠加渐变条（从浅到深展示同色系），帮助模型理解色调范围\n- 返回 Blob 对象，供上传流程使用\n\n生成后自动调用现有的 `uploadFile`（来自 `@tap/endpoints`）上传，然后设置为 `referenceImageUrl`。这复用了 [FaceEditControls.tsx](packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditControls.tsx) 中已有的参考图机制（第 69 行 `referenceImageUrl` 状态和第 464-512 行 UI）。\n\n### 2. 描述性 Prompt 生成\n\n根据选色结果和场景，自动拼装 Prompt 文本模板：\n\n- 场景 + 颜色名 + HEX + 类比描述\n- 中文示例：`\"将人物的发色改为暗红色(#8B0000)，类似红酒般的深沉红色调\"`\n- 英文示例：`\"Change hair color to dark red (#8B0000), a deep wine-red tone\"`\n\n颜色名称映射使用 HSL 区间匹配算法，将任意 HEX 值映射到最接近的中文颜色名，并附带一个类比短语。\n\n### 3. 色轮组件\n\n自定义 Canvas 色轮 `ColorWheel.tsx`：\n- 外圈 Hue 环（360 度色相）\n- 内部矩形/三角 SV 选择区（饱和度 + 明度）\n- 鼠标拖拽 + 触摸支持\n- 不引入额外依赖，纯 Canvas API 绘制\n\n### 4. EyeDropper 取色\n\n使用浏览器原生 `EyeDropper API`（Chrome 95+），从屏幕任意位置吸取颜色。不支持的浏览器自动隐藏该按钮。\n\n## 文件变更\n\n### 新增文件\n\n- **`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/color-presets.ts`**\n  - 分类预设色板数据（发色、唇色、眼影、腮红、肤色）\n  - `getColorName(hex): { name: string, analogy: string }` - HSL 区间匹配的颜色名称映射\n  - `generateColorSwatch(hex): Blob` - Canvas 生成纯色色块参考图\n  - `buildColorPrompt(hex, scene, lang): string` - 拼装描述性 Prompt 文本\n  - HSL/HEX 互转工具函数\n\n- **`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/ColorWheel.tsx`**\n  - Canvas 色轮组件\n  - Props: `value: string`（HEX）, `onChange: (hex: string) => void`, `size?: number`\n\n- **`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditColorTool.tsx`**\n  - 色彩工具主面板 Popover\n  - 组合：色轮 + 场景选择 Tab（发色/唇色/眼影/腮红）+ 预设色板 + 取色器 + 颜色信息 + 应用按钮\n  - Props: `onApplyColor: (prompt: string, swatchBlob: Blob) => void`\n\n### 修改文件\n\n- **[FaceEditControls.tsx](packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditControls.tsx)**\n  - 在 Prompt label 行（第 516 行）右侧添加色彩工具触发按钮（色轮图标）\n  - 新增 `handleApplyColor` 回调：\n    1. 将颜色描述文本写入/追加到 `prompt` 状态\n    2. 将色块 Blob 上传（复用 `uploadFile`），结果设为 `referenceImageUrl`\n  - 需要将 `setReferenceImageUrl` 暴露给 `FaceEditColorTool` 或通过回调传递\n\n- **[index.ts](packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/index.ts)**\n  - 导出 `FaceEditColorTool`\n\n- **[locales/zh_CN/canvas.json](locales/zh_CN/canvas.json)** 和 **[locales/en_US/canvas.json](locales/en_US/canvas.json)**\n  - `faceEdit` 段新增：`colorTool`, `applyColor`, `presetHair`, `presetLip`, `presetEyeshadow`, `presetBlush`, `pickFromImage`, `recentColors`, `colorScene`, `colorApplied` 等\n\n## UI 布局\n\n``​`\n+------------------------------------+\n|  [色轮 - Hue环 + SV区域]          |\n|           (180x180)                |\n+------------------------------------+\n|  [发色] [唇色] [眼影] [腮红]  Tab  |\n+------------------------------------+\n|  [色块][色块][色块][色块][色块]...  |\n|  [色块][色块][色块][色块][色块]...  |\n+------------------------------------+\n|  最近使用  [色块] [色块] ...       |\n+------------------------------------+\n|  [大色块] 暗红色 #8B0000           |\n|  \"类似红酒般深沉红色调\"            |\n|  [吸管取色]          [应用颜色]    |\n+------------------------------------+\n``​`\n\nPopover 宽度约 280px，`side=\"left\"` 弹出。点击\"应用颜色\"后：\n- 自动生成色块图并设为参考图（参考图区域显示纯色色块）\n- Prompt 自动填入/追加颜色描述文本\n- 用户可微调 Prompt 后点\"生成\""
}

### 🤖 Agent

计划已更新。核心变化是：

**问题**：单纯插入颜色名称（如"暗红色"）确实不足以让模型精确还原颜色。AI 模型对颜色名称的理解是模糊的、非确定性的。

**改进方案：双通道颜色传递**

1. **视觉通道 -- 色块参考图**：用户选色后，系统用 Canvas 自动生成一张纯色色块图（256x256），上传后自动设置为"参考图"。这样模型可以直接"看到"目标颜色，比文字描述精确得多。这复用了面板中已有的参考图上传机制。

2. **文字通道 -- 描述性 Prompt**：在 Prompt 中插入多维度描述，不只是一个颜色名，而是"颜色名 + HEX 值 + 类比描述"的组合。例如：
   - `"将人物的发色改为暗红色(#8B0000)，类似红酒般的深沉红色调"`

两条通道互补，让模型同时获得视觉和语义两层参考信息，最大化颜色还原的准确性。

如果方案没有问题，可以确认后我开始实现。

(y - sqTop) / sqSize));\n      setSat(newSat);\n      setVal(newVal);\n      const { r, g, b } = hsvToRgb(hue, newSat, newVal);\n      onChange(rgbToHex(r, g, b));\n    },\n    [center, squareInset, hue, onChange],\n  );\n\n  const handlePointerDown = useCallback(\n    (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {\n      e.preventDefault();\n      const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(e);\n      const target = hitTest(x, y);\n      if (!target) return;\n      dragRef.current = target;\n      if (target === \"ring\") updateFromRing(x, y);\n      else updateFromSquare(x, y);\n    },\n    [getCanvasCoords, hitTest, updateFromRing, updateFromSquare],\n  );\n\n  const handlePointerMove = useCallback(\n    (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {\n      if (!dragRef.current) return;\n      e.preventDefault();\n      const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(e);\n      if (dragRef.current === \"ring\") updateFromRing(x, y);\n      else updateFromSquare(x, y);\n    },\n    [getCanvasCoords, updateFromRing, updateFromSquare],\n  );\n\n  const handlePointerUp = useCallback(() => {\n    dragRef.current = null;\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const up = () => {\n      dragRef.current = null;\n    };\n    window.addEventListener(\"mouseup\", up);\n    window.addEventListener(\"touchend\", up);\n    return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener(\"mouseup\", up);\n      window.removeEventListener(\"touchend\", up);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <canvas\n      ref={canvasRef}\n      style={{ width: size, height: size, cursor: \"crosshair\", touchAction: \"none\" }}\n      onMouseDown={handlePointerDown}\n      onMouseMove={handlePointerMove}\n      onMouseUp={handlePointerUp}\n      onTouchStart={handlePointerDown}\n      onTouchMove={handlePointerMove}\n      onTouchEnd={handlePointerUp}\n    />\n  );\n});\n\nColorWheel.displayName = \"ColorWheel\";\n"
}

所有任务已完成。以下是实现的完整总结：

## 新增文件

1. **`color-presets.ts`** - 核心数据与工具层
   - 4 组分类预设色板（发色 20 色、唇色 16 色、眼影 12 色、腮红 10 色）
   - 60+ 命名颜色的 RGB 距离最近邻匹配算法（`getColorName`）
   - `generateColorSwatch(hex)` - Canvas 生成 256x256 纯色色块图（底部附带同色系渐变条），返回 Blob
   - `buildColorPrompt(hex, scene, lang)` - 自动拼装多维度描述：`"将人物的发色改为暗红(#8B0000)，红酒般深沉红"`
   - 完整的 HSL/HSV/HEX/RGB 互转工具函数

The user is saying there are visible artifacts/fine lines on the color wheel. This is a common issue with drawing color wheels using Canvas API when drawing individual arc segments - gaps appear between the segments. Let me look at the current ColorWheel implementation to fix the rendering.

- 🔧 **Read** `{ "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\face-editor\\fe-app-tapnow-main\\packages\\canvas\\src\\core\\components\\face-edit\\ColorWheel.tsx" }`

### 🤖 Agent

问题出在色环的绘制方式 -- 当前用 360 个独立圆弧拼接，弧段之间会出现细纹间隙。我用 `createConicGradient` 重写为平滑渐变环。

The issue is the hue ring rendering. Currently it draws 360 individual arc segments with 1-degree steps, which causes visible gaps/seams between segments. The fix is to use a conic gradient (which modern browsers support) or draw with overlapping arcs.

The best approach for a smooth hue ring:
1. Use `ctx.createConicGradient()` if available (Chrome 99+, modern browsers)
2. Or draw with ImageData pixel-by-pixel for the ring area
3. Or increase overlap between arc segments

The simplest and most effective fix: use a conic gradient to fill the ring, which gives perfectly smooth color transitions. 

Now I'll implement this with a clipping mask to define the ring shape, then apply the conic gradient within those bounds for a clean, seamless result.

- 🔧 **StrReplace**

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\face-editor\\fe-app-tapnow-main\\packages\\canvas\\src\\core\\components\\face-edit\\ColorWheel.tsx",
 "old_string": "    // Hue ring\n    for (let angle = 0; angle < 360; angle += 1) {\n      const startAngle = ((angle - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;\n      const endAngle = ((angle - 89) * Math.PI) / 180;\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(cx, cy, (outerR + innerR) / 2, startAngle, endAngle);\n      ctx.lineWidth = ringWidth;\n      ctx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${angle}, 100%, 50%)`;\n      ctx.stroke();\n    }",
 "new_string": "    // Hue ring — use conic gradient for smooth rendering (no seams)\n    const conicSupported = typeof ctx.createConicGradient === \"function\";\n    if (conicSupported) {\n      const conic = ctx.createConicGradient(-Math.PI / 2, cx, cy);\n      for (let i = 0; i <= 360; i += 1) {\n        conic.addColorStop(i / 360, `hsl(${i}, 100%, 50%)`);\n      }\n      ctx.save();\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerR, 0, TAU);\n      ctx.arc(cx, cy, innerR, 0, TAU, true);\n      ctx.clip();\n      ctx.fillStyle = conic;\n      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);\n      ctx.restore();\n    } else {\n      // Fallback: overlapping arcs for older browsers\n      const step = 0.5;\n      const overlap = 1;\n      for (let angle = 0; angle < 360; angle += step) {\n        const startAngle = ((angle - 90 - overlap) * Math.PI) / 180;\n        const endAngle = ((angle - 90 + step + overlap) * Math.PI) / 180;\n        ctx.beginPath();\n        ctx.arc(cx, cy, (outerR + innerR) / 2, startAngle, endAngle);\n        ctx.lineWidth = ringWidth + 1;\n        ctx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${angle}, 100%, 50%)`;\n        ctx.stroke();\n      }\n    }"
}

已修复。核心改动：

**之前**：用 360 个 1 度的独立 `arc` + `stroke` 拼接色环，弧段之间的抗锯齿间隙导致细纹。

**现在**：使用 `createConicGradient` 绘制锥形渐变，然后通过环形 clip path（外圆 - 内圆）裁剪出色环。这是浏览器原生的渐变插值，完全平滑无接缝。同时保留了一个 fallback 分支给不支持 conic gradient 的老浏览器（使用更小步长 + 重叠弧段来消除细纹）。

## 实现完成

按照计划完成了所有 7 项任务，创建/修改了以下文件：

### 新增文件

1. **`color-presets.ts`** — 色彩工具核心逻辑
   - 4 类预设色板（发色 20 色、唇色 15 色、眼影 15 色、腮红 10 色）
   - `hexToHsl` / `hslToHex` / `rgbToHex` 等 HSL↔HEX↔RGB 互转工具函数
   - `getColorName(hex)` — HSL 区间匹配算法，返回中英文名称 + 类比描述
   - `generateColorSwatch(hex)` — Canvas 生成 256×256 纯色色块图 + 底部渐变条，返回 `Blob`
   - `buildColorPrompt(hex, scene, lang)` — 拼装多维度颜色描述 Prompt

2. **`ColorWheel.tsx`** — 纯 Canvas 色轮组件
   - 外圈 360° Hue 色相环 + 内部 SV 矩形选择区
   - 鼠标拖拽 + 触摸支持，支持 DPR 高清渲染
   - HSV ↔ HSL 正确转换，指示器精准定位

3. **`FaceEditColorTool.tsx`** — 色彩工具主面板 Popover
   - 色轮 + 场景 Tab（发色/唇色/眼影/腮红）+ 预设色块网格
   - 最近使用颜色（localStorage 持久化，最多 8 个）
   - 颜色信息展示（名称 + HEX + 类比描述）
   - EyeDropper API 取色（不支持的浏览器自动隐藏）
   - 宽度 280px，`side="left"` 弹出

### 修改文件

4. **`FaceEditControls.tsx`** — 清理了重复 import，集成了 `FaceEditColorTool`（Prompt 标签行右侧色轮图标触发），通过 `handleApplyColor` 回调自动上传色块图设为参考图 + 追加 Prompt 文本

5. **`index.ts`** — 清理了重复导出，正确导出 `FaceEditColorTool`

6. **`locales/zh_CN/canvas.json`** + **`locales/en_US/canvas.json`** — 新增 `presetHair`, `presetLip`, `presetEyeshadow`, `presetBlush`, `colorScene` 等国际化 key

 "contents": "import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { hexToRgb, hsvToRgb, rgbToHex, rgbToHsv } from \"./color-presets\";\n\ninterface ColorWheelProps {\n  value: string;\n  onChange: (hex: string) => void;\n  size?: number;\n}\n\nconst TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;\n\nexport const ColorWheel = memo(({ value, onChange, size = 180 }: ColorWheelProps) => {\n  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);\n  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState<\"hue\" | \"sv\" | null>(null);\n\n  const rgb = hexToRgb(value);\n  const hsv = rgbToHsv(rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b);\n\n  const outerRadius = size / 2;\n  const ringWidth = size * 0.1;\n  const innerRadius = outerRadius - ringWidth - 2;\n  const svSize = Math.floor(innerRadius * Math.sqrt(2));\n  const svOffset = Math.floor((size - svSize) / 2);\n\n  const drawWheel = useCallback(() => {\n    const canvas = canvasRef.current;\n    if (!canvas) return;\n    const ctx = canvas.getContext(\"2d\");\n    if (!ctx) return;\n\n    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n    canvas.width = size * dpr;\n    canvas.height = size * dpr;\n    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);\n\n    const cx = size / 2;\n    const cy = size / 2;\n\n    // Hue ring\n    for (let angle = 0; angle < 360; angle += 1) {\n      const startAngle = ((angle - 1) * Math.PI) / 180;\n      const endAngle = ((angle + 1) * Math.PI) / 180;\n      const { r, g, b } = hsvToRgb(angle, 1, 1);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerRadius - ringWidth / 2, startAngle, endAngle);\n      ctx.lineWidth = ringWidth;\n      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;\n      ctx.stroke();\n    }\n\n    // SV rectangle\n    const svImageData = ctx.createImageData(svSize, svSize);\n    for (let y = 0; y < svSize; y++) {\n      for (let x = 0; x < svSize; x++) {\n        const s = x / (svSize - 1);\n        const v = 1 - y / (svSize - 1);\n        const { r, g, b } = hsvToRgb(hsv.h, s, v);\n        const idx = (y * svSize + x) * 4;\n        svImageData.data[idx] = r;\n        svImageData.data[idx + 1] = g;\n        svImageData.data[idx + 2] = b;\n        svImageData.data[idx + 3] = 255;\n      }\n    }\n    ctx.putImageData(svImageData, svOffset, svOffset);\n\n    // Hue indicator\n    const hueAngle = (hsv.h * Math.PI) / 180;\n    const hueX = cx + Math.cos(hueAngle) * (outerRadius - ringWidth / 2);\n    const hueY = cy + Math.sin(hueAngle) * (outerRadius - ringWidth / 2);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(hueX, hueY, ringWidth / 2 + 1, 0, TWO_PI);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#fff\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 2;\n    ctx.stroke();\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(hueX, hueY, ringWidth / 2 + 2.5, 0, TWO_PI);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"rgba(0,0,0,0.3)\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    // SV indicator\n    const svX = svOffset + hsv.s * (svSize - 1);\n    const svY = svOffset + (1 - hsv.v) * (svSize - 1);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(svX, svY, 6, 0, TWO_PI);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#fff\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 2;\n    ctx.stroke();\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(svX, svY, 7.5, 0, TWO_PI);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"rgba(0,0,0,0.3)\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }, [size, outerRadius, ringWidth, svSize, svOffset, hsv.h, hsv.s, hsv.v]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    drawWheel();\n  }, [drawWheel]);\n\n  const getPosition = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {\n    const canvas = canvasRef.current;\n    if (!canvas) return { x: 0, y: 0 };\n    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();\n    const clientX = \"touches\" in e ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;\n    const clientY = \"touches\" in e ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;\n    return {\n      x: ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * size,\n      y: ((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * size,\n    };\n  };\n\n  const hitTest = (x: number, y: number): \"hue\" | \"sv\" | null => {\n    const cx = size / 2;\n    const cy = size / 2;\n    const dist = Math.sqrt((x - cx) ** 2 + (y - cy) ** 2);\n    if (dist >= innerRadius && dist <= outerRadius) return \"hue\";\n    if (\n      x >= svOffset &&\n      x <= svOffset + svSize &&\n      y >= svOffset &&\n      y <= svOffset + svSize\n    )\n      return \"sv\";\n    return null;\n  };\n\n  const updateFromHue = useCallback(\n    (x: number, y: number) => {\n      const cx = size / 2;\n      const cy = size / 2;\n      let angle = (Math.atan2(y - cy, x - cx) * 180) / Math.PI;\n      if (angle < 0) angle += 360;\n      const { r, g, b } = hsvToRgb(angle, hsv.s, hsv.v);\n      onChange(rgbToHex(r, g, b));\n    },\n    [size, hsv.s, hsv.v, onChange],\n  );\n\n  const updateFromSV = useCallback(\n    (x: number, y: number) => {\n      const s = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - svOffset) / (svSize - 1)));\n      const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (y - svOffset) / (svSize - 1)));\n      const { r, g, b } = hsvToRgb(hsv.h, s, v);\n      onChange(rgbToHex(r, g, b));\n    },\n    [svOffset, svSize, hsv.h, onChange],\n  );\n\n  const handleStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const { x, y } = getPosition(e);\n    const zone = hitTest(x, y);\n    if (!zone) return;\n    setDragging(zone);\n    if (zone === \"hue\") updateFromHue(x, y);\n    else updateFromSV(x, y);\n  };\n\n  const handleMove = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {\n    if (!dragging) return;\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const { x, y } = getPosition(e);\n    if (dragging === \"hue\") updateFromHue(x, y);\n    else updateFromSV(x, y);\n  };\n\n  const handleEnd = () => setDragging(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!dragging) return;\n    const up = () => setDragging(null);\n    window.addEventListener(\"mouseup\", up);\n    window.addEventListener(\"touchend\", up);\n    return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener(\"mouseup\", up);\n      window.removeEventListener(\"touchend\", up);\n    };\n  }, [dragging]);\n\n  return (\n    <canvas\n      ref={canvasRef}\n      style={{ width: size, height: size, cursor: \"crosshair\", touchAction: \"none\" }}\n      onMouseDown={handleStart}\n      onMouseMove={handleMove}\n      onMouseUp={handleEnd}\n      onTouchStart={handleStart}\n      onTouchMove={handleMove}\n      onTouchEnd={handleEnd}\n    />\n  );\n});\n\nColorWheel.displayName = \"ColorWheel\";\n"
}

 <IconPalette size={14} className=\"text-muted-foreground\" />\n            </button>\n          </PopoverTrigger>\n        </TooltipTrigger>\n        <TooltipContent side=\"top\" sideOffset={8}\n        className=\"w-[280px] p-3 space-y-3 bg-popover border border-border rounded-xl shadow-lg\"\n      >\n        {/* Color Wheel */}\n        <div className=\"flex {SCENES.map((s) => (\n            <button\n              key={s}\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setScene(s)}\n              className={cn(\n                \"flex-1 px-1.5 py-1 text-[10px] rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer\",\n                s === scene\n                  ? \"bg-primary text-primary-foreground\"\n                  : \"bg-muted/50 ## 实现完成

### 新增文件

1. **`ColorWheel.tsx`** — 纯 Canvas 色轮组件
   - 外圈 Hue 色相环（360 度）
   - 内部矩形 SV 选择区（饱和度 + 明度）
   - 支持鼠标拖拽 + 触摸操作
   - 高 DPI (devicePixelRatio) 适配
   - 无额外依赖，纯 Canvas API 绘制

2. **`FaceEditColorTool.tsx`** — 色彩工具主面板 Popover
   - 色轮 + 场景 Tab（发色/唇色/眼影/腮红）+ 预设色板
   - EyeDropper 取色支持（不支持的浏览器自动隐藏）
   - 颜色信息展示（中文名 + HEX + 类比描述）
   - 最近使用颜色（localStorage 持久化，最多 8 个）
   - 点击"应用颜色"后自动生成色块参考图 + Prompt 文本

用户选色后点击"应用颜色"，系统通过**双通道**提高颜色还原精度：

rect.left) * (canvasRef.current!.width / rect.width);\n  const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvasRef.current!.height / rect.height);\n  const [r, g, b] = ctx.getImageData(x, y, 1, 1).data;\n  onColorPick(rgbToHex(r, g, b));\n};\n``​`\n\n### 2. 修改 `FaceEditColorTool.tsx`\n\n路径：[FaceEditColorTool.tsx](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditColorTool.tsx)\n\n改动：\n- 新增状态 `showRefPicker` 控制是否展示参考图取色模式\n- 在 Popover 顶部添加一个小切换按钮（图标：`ImagePlus` 或类似）\n- 当 `showRefPicker=true` 时，用 `ImageColorPicker` 替代 `ColorWheel` 的位置\n- 当 `showRefPicker=false` 时，保持原有 ColorWheel\n- `ImageColorPicker.onColorPick` 写入 `setSelectedHex`\n- Popover 宽度在参考图模式下适当加宽（约 320px）以便图片展示\n\n### 3. 更新国际化翻译\n\n- [zh_CN/canvas.json](fe-app-tapnow-main/locales/zh_CN/canvas.json)：添加 `faceEdit.refImagePick`（\"参考图取色\"）、`faceEdit.pasteOrUpload`（\"粘贴或上传图片\"）、`faceEdit.clickToPickColor`（\"点击图片取色\"）、`faceEdit.removeRefImage`（\"移除参考图\"）\n- [en_US/canvas.json](fe-app-tapnow-main/locales/en_US/canvas.json)：添加对应英文翻译\n\n### 4. 导出更新\n\n路径：[index.ts](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/index.ts) — 如需要则导出新组件（内部使用可选）。\n\n## 交互细节\n\n- 参考图区域尺寸：宽度充满 popover（约 260px 内容区），高度按比例自适应，最大 200px\n- 鼠标样式：`crosshair`，悬停时在 canvas 上叠加一个跟随光标的颜色预览圆（通过 `mousemove` 时重绘 overlay）\n- 图片加载跨域：使用 `img.crossOrigin = \"anonymous\"` 或直接从本地文件读取，避免 canvas 被污染（tainted canvas 无法 getImageData）\n- 粘贴支持：在 Popover 打开 + 参考图模式下，监听 document 级 paste 事件\n- 移除图片后自动切回色轮模式\n",

让我优化一下组件设计，使用双 canvas 方案更简洁 —— 底层 canvas 存图片数据，上层 canvas 负责交互和悬停预览。

Wait, I realize there's an issue with my approach. Having 3 canvases is overly complex and the invisible interaction layer won't properly size itself since the canvas ref might not have the right dimensions on first render. Let me simplify this.

Actually, the issue is that:
1. The main canvas holds the image data (needed for getImageData)
2. The overlay canvas draws the cursor preview
3. The interaction layer captures mouse events

A simpler approach: just use 2 canvases - the main canvas for image data, and an overlay for the cursor preview. The overlay can capture mouse events directly. Actually, even simpler - we can just use a single canvas approach where we redraw the image + overlay on every mouse move. But that's inefficient.


Better approach: use the main canvas for image data (never modified after loading), use the overlay canvas for the cursor visualization AND mouse events. On mouse move, we read from the main canvas and draw on the overlay canvas.

### 🤖 Agent

让我再优化一下方案 —— 用 `<img>` 显示图片，隐藏 canvas 存像素数据，overlay canvas 画悬停指示器。这样更高效。

Wait, there's a problem with the overlay canvas approach. The overlay canvas doesn't contain the image data - it's just an overlay. So the user would see nothing - just the overlay.

The proper approach should be:
1. Data canvas: hidden, holds full-res image data for pixel reading
2. Overlay canvas: visible, needs to show the image AND draw the hover indicator on top

So after loading the image into the data canvas, I also need to draw the image onto the overlay canvas. Then on mouse move, I need to redraw the image + the hover indicator on the overlay.

Actually, a simpler approach: just use a single canvas approach. 

But re-drawing the full image every mouse move is potentially expensive for large images. A cleaner solution is to use an `<img>` element to display the image efficiently, keep a hidden canvas with the same image data for pixel reading, and layer an overlay canvas on top to draw just the hover cursor preview.

 "contents": "import { IconPhoto, IconSend, IconX } from \"@tabler/icons-react\";\nimport {\n  IMAGE_LLM_MODELS,\n  IMAGE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES,\n  useImageGeneration,\n} from \"../../../hooks/use-tapflow-operate\";\nimport { getCenterPosition } from \"../../../lib/helpers\";\n\nconst SUPPORTED_MODELS: IMAGE_LLM_MODELS[] = [\n  IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.FLUX_KONTEXT_PRO,\n  IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.GEMINI_BANANA_2,\n  IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.SEEDREAM_4_0,\n  IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.GPT_IMAGE_1,\n  IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.WAN_2_7_PRO,\n];\n\ninterface FaceEditPromptBarProps {\n  node: AppNode;\n  onClose: () => void;\n  selectedIndex: number;\n  onSelectResult: (index: number) => void;\n  onGeneratingChange: (generating: boolean) => void;\n}\n\nexport const FaceEditPromptBar = memo(\n  ({\n    node,\n    onClose,\n    selectedIndex,\n    onSelectResult,\n    onGeneratingChange,\n  }: FaceEditPromptBarProps) => {\n    const { t } = useTranslation();\n    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n    const { generatedImages: allGeneratedImages, assetItem } = useFaceEdit();\n    const { addImages } = useFaceEditActions();\n    const { setNodes, getViewport, fitView, updateNodeData } = useReactFlow();\n\n    const assetId = assetItem?.nodeId || node.id;\n    const src = (node.data as any)?.src || assetItem?.src || \"\";\n\n    const generatedImages = useMemo(\n      () => allGeneratedImages[assetId] || [],\n      [allGeneratedImages, assetId],\n    );\n\n    const selectedResultUrl =\n      generatedImages.length > 0\n        ? generatedImages[selectedIndex] || generatedImages[0]\n        : null;\n\n    const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState(\"\");\n    const [model, setModel] = useState<IMAGE_LLM_MODELS>(\n      IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.FLUX_KONTEXT_PRO,\n    );\n    const [aspectRatio, setAspectRatio] = useState(\"1:1\");\n    const [referenceImageUrl, setReferenceImageUrl] = useState<string | null>(\n      null,\n    );\n    const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n    const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);\n\n    const { send: sendImageGeneration } = useImageGeneration();\n\n    const availableRatios = useMemo(() => {\n      const modelCaps = IMAGE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES[model];\n      const ratios = modelCaps?.options?.aspectRatios;\n      if (!ratios) return [\"1:1\", \"4:3\", \"3:4\", \"16:9\", \"9:16\", \"3:2\", \"2:3\"];\n      if (typeof ratios === \"function\") return ratios({});\n      return ratios;\n    }, [model]);\n\n    const handleFileSelect = useCallback(\n      async (file: File) => {\n        if (!file.type.startsWith(\"image/\")) {\n          toast.error(t(\"assets.uploadImageOnly\"));\n          return;\n        }\n        if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {\n          toast.error(t(\"assets.fileSizeExceeded\"));\n          return;\n        }\n\n        const localUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);\n        setReferenceImageUrl(localUrl);\n\n        try {\n          setUploading(true);\n          const result = await uploadFile(file);\n          const url = result.fileInfo?.url;\n          if (url) {\n            setReferenceImageUrl(url);\n          }\n        } catch {\n          toast.error(t(\"assets.imageUploadFailed\"));\n        } finally {\n          setUploading(false);\n        }\n      },\n      [t],\n    );\n\n    const handleRemoveReference = useCallback(() => {\n      setReferenceImageUrl(null);\n      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = \"\";\n    }, []);\n\n    const callWanxiangDirect = useCallback(\n      async (promptText: string, imageUrls: string[]) => {\n        const apiKey = \"***REDACTED-OPENAI_KEY***\";\n\n        const content: Array<Record<string, string>> = [];\n        for (const url of imageUrls) {\n          if (url && !url.startsWith(\"blob:\")) {\n            content.push({ image: url });\n          }\n        }\n        content.push({ text: promptText || \"edit this character\" });\n\n        const resp = await fetch(\n          \"/dashscope-api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation\",\n          {\n            method: \"POST\",\n            headers: {\n              \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n              Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,\n            },\n            body: JSON.stringify({\n              model: \"wan2.7-image-pro\",\n              input: { messages: [{ role: \"user\", content }] },\n              parameters: { size: \"2K\", n: 1, watermark: false },\n            }),\n          },\n        );\n\n        if (!resp.ok) {\n          const errBody = await resp.text();\n          throw new Error(`DashScope API error ${resp.status}: ${errBody}`);\n        }\n\n        const data = await resp.json();\n        const choices = data?.output?.choices || [];\n        const urls: string[] = [];\n        for (const choice of choices) {\n          const items = choice?.message?.content || [];\n          for (const item of items) {\n            if (item.image) urls.push(item.image);\n          }\n        }\n        return urls;\n      },\n      [],\n    );\n\n    const handleGenerated = useCallback(\n      (urls: string[]) => {\n        addImages(assetId, urls);\n        const currentLen = allGeneratedImages[assetId]?.length || 0;\n        onSelectResult(currentLen + urls.length - 1);\n      },\n      [assetId, addImages, allGeneratedImages, onSelectResult],\n    );\n\n    const handleGenerate = useCallback(async () => {\n      if (!prompt.trim() && !referenceImageUrl) return;\n      if (generating) return;\n\n      setGenerating(true);\n      onGeneratingChange(true);\n\n      try {\n        const images: string[] = [src];\n        if (referenceImageUrl && !referenceImageUrl.startsWith(\"blob:\")) {\n          images.push(referenceImageUrl);\n        }\n\n        if (model === IMAGE_LLM_MODELS.WAN_2_7_PRO) {\n          const urls = await callWanxiangDirect(prompt.trim(), images);\n          if (urls.length > 0) {\n            handleGenerated(urls);\n          } else {\n            toast.error(t(\"faceEdit.generateFailed\"), {\n              description: \"No image returned\",\n            });\n          }\n          setGenerating(false);\n          onGeneratingChange(false);\n          return;\n        }\n\n        await sendImageGeneration(\n          {\n            model,\n            frontendParams: {\n              mode: \"text_to_image\" as any,\n              prompt: prompt.trim() || \"edit this character\",\n              aspectRatio,\n              times: 1,\n              images: images.length > 0 ? images : undefined,\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            onTaskComplete: (result: any) => {\n              const genImages =\n                result?.generated_images || result?.images || [];\n              const urls = genImages\n                .map((img: any) => img?.url || img)\n                .filter(Boolean) as string[];\n              if (urls.length > 0) {\n                handleGenerated(urls);\n              }\n              setGenerating(false);\n              onGeneratingChange(false);\n            },\n            onTaskError: (error: any) => {\n              toast.error(t(\"faceEdit.generateFailed\"), {\n                description: typeof error === \"string\" ? error : undefined,\n              });\n              setGenerating(false);\n              onGeneratingChange(false);\n            },\n          },\n        );\n      } catch (err) {\n        toast.error(t(\"faceEdit.generateFailed\"), {\n          description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined,\n        });\n        setGenerating(false);\n        onGeneratingChange(false);\n      }\n    }, [\n      prompt,\n      referenceImageUrl,\n      generating,\n      src,\n      sendImageGeneration,\n      callWanxiangDirect,\n      model,\n      aspectRatio,\n      handleGenerated,\n      onGeneratingChange,\n      t,\n    ]);\n\n    const handleApplyColor = useCallback(\n      async (promptText: string, swatchBlob: Blob) => {\n        setPrompt((prev) =>\n          prev.trim() ? `${prev.trim()}\\n${promptText}` : promptText,\n        );\n        try {\n          setUploading(true);\n          const file = new File([swatchBlob], \"color-swatch.png\", {\n            type: \"image/png\",\n          });\n          const result = await uploadFile(file);\n          const url = result.fileInfo?.url;\n          if (url) {\n            setReferenceImageUrl(url);\n          } else {\n            const localUrl = URL.createObjectURL(swatchBlob);\n            setReferenceImageUrl(localUrl);\n          }\n        } catch {\n          const localUrl = URL.createObjectURL(swatchBlob);\n          setReferenceImageUrl(localUrl);\n        } finally {\n          setUploading(false);\n        }\n      },\n      [],\n    );\n\n    const handleApplyToNode = useCallback(() => {\n      if (!selectedResultUrl) return;\n      updateNodeData(node.id, { src: selectedResultUrl });\n      toast.success(t(\"faceEdit.saveSuccess\"));\n    }, [selectedResultUrl, node.id, updateNodeData, t]);\n\n    const handleAddToCanvas = useCallback(async () => {\n      if (!selectedResultUrl) return;\n\n      const nodeTemplate = await createFactory(NodeType.IMAGE, {\n        type: ImageProcessType.UPLOAD,\n        src: selectedResultUrl,\n        label: assetItem?.title || \"Face Edit Result\",\n      });\n\n      if (!nodeTemplate) return;\n\n      const position = getCenterPosition(getViewport());\n      const newNode = { ...nodeTemplate, position } as any;\n\n      setNodes((prev) => [...prev, newNode]);\n\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        fitView({ duration: 300, nodes: [{ id: newNode.id }] });\n      }, 200);\n\n      toast.success(t(\"faceEdit.addedToCanvas\"));\n    }, [\n      selectedResultUrl,\n      assetItem,\n      setNodes,\n      getViewport,\n      fitView,\n      t,\n    ]);\n\n    const canGenerate = prompt.trim().length > 0 || !!referenceImageUrl;\n\n    return (\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-background/90 backdrop-blur shadow-xl border border-border w-[500px]\">\n        {/* Row 1: Prompt textarea */}\n        <Textarea\n          placeholder={t(\"faceEdit.prompt\")}\n          value={prompt}\n          onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}\n          className=\"resize-none min-h-[56px] max-h-[80px] text-sm bg-transparent border-muted\"\n          onKeyDown={(e) => {\n            if (e.key === \"Enter\" && !e.shiftKey) {\n              e.preventDefault();\n              handleGenerate();\n            }\n          }}\n        />\n\n        {/* Row 2: Controls */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\n          {/* Reference image */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {referenceImageUrl ? (\n              <div className=\"relative group w-8 h-8 rounded overflow-hidden border border-border shrink-0\">\n                <img\n                  src={referenceImageUrl}\n                  alt=\"Ref\"\n                  className=\"w-full h-full object-cover\"\n                />\n                {uploading && (\n                  <div className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center\">\n                    <Loader2 className=\"w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-white\" />\n                  </div>\n                )}\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={handleRemoveReference}\n                  className=\"absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 p-0.5 bg-black/70 text-white rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity cursor-pointer\"\n                >\n                  <IconX size={8} />\n                </button>\n              </div>\n            ) : (\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded border border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors shrink-0\"\n                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}\n                title={t(\"faceEdit.referenceImage\")}\n              >\n                <IconPhoto size={14} className=\"text-muted-foreground\" />\n              </button>\n            )}\n            <input\n              ref={fileInputRef}\n              type=\"file\"\n              accept=\"image/*\"\n              className=\"hidden\"\n              onChange={(e) => {\n                const file = e.target.files?.[0];\n                if (file) handleFileSelect(file);\n              }}\n            />\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Color tool */}\n          <FaceEditColorTool onApplyColor={handleApplyColor} />\n\n          {/* Model selector */}\n          <Select\n            value={model}\n            onValueChange={(v) => setModel(v as IMAGE_LLM_MODELS)}\n          >\n            <SelectTrigger className=\"h-7 text-[10px] w-[110px] shrink-0\">\n              <SelectValue />\n            </SelectTrigger>\n            <SelectContent>\n              {SUPPORTED_MODELS.map((m) => {\n                const caps = IMAGE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES[m];\n                return (\n                  <SelectItem key={m} value={m}>\n                    {caps ? t(caps.name) : m}\n                  </SelectItem>\n                );\n              })}\n            </SelectContent>\n          </Select>\n\n          {/* Aspect ratio */}\n          <Select value={aspectRatio} onValueChange={setAspectRatio}>\n            <SelectTrigger className=\"h-7 text-[10px] w-[60px] shrink-0\">\n              <SelectValue />\n            </SelectTrigger>\n            <SelectContent>\n              {availableRatios.map((ratio: string) => (\n                <SelectItem key={ratio} value={ratio}>\n                  {ratio}\n                </SelectItem>\n              ))}\n            </SelectContent>\n          </Select>\n\n          <div className=\"flex-1\" />\n\n          {/* Action buttons for generated results */}\n          {selectedResultUrl && (\n            <>\n              <Button\n                variant=\"outline\"\n                size=\"sm\"\n                className=\"h-7 gap-1 text-[10px] px-2\"\n                onClick={handleApplyToNode}\n              >\n                <Save size={12} />\n                {t(\"faceEdit.saveToAsset\")}\n              </Button>\n              <Button\n                variant=\"outline\"\n                size=\"sm\"\n                className=\"h-7 gap-1 text-[10px] px-2\"\n                onClick={handleAddToCanvas}\n              >\n                <Download size={12} />\n                {t(\"faceEdit.addToCanvas\")}\n              </Button>\n            </>\n          )}\n\n          {/* Generate button */}\n          <Button\n            size=\"sm\"\n            className=\"h-7 gap-1.5 px-3\"\n            disabled={!canGenerate || generating}\n            onClick={handleGenerate}\n          >\n            {generating ? (\n              <>\n                <Loader2 className=\"w-3 h-3 animate-spin\" />\n                <span className=\"text-xs\">{t(\"faceEdit.generating\")}</span>\n              </>\n            ) : (\n              <>\n                <IconSend size={14} />\n                <span className=\"text-xs\">{t(\"faceEdit.generate\")}</span>\n              </>\n            )}\n          </Button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  },\n);\n\nFaceEditPromptBar.displayName = \"FaceEditPromptBar\";\n"
}

所有任务已完成。以下是变更总结：

## 变更总结

### 核心改动

1. **`media-space-store.ts`** — `FloatingEditorMode` 联合类型新增 `"face-edit"`；`openFaceEdit` 现在在有 `nodeId` 时自动调用 `openFloatingEditor(nodeId, "face-edit")` 将修容面板委托给浮动编辑器系统。

2. **`EditorContainer.tsx`** — 在三个渲染分支中新增 `face-edit` 模式：
   - `renderTopBar`: face-edit 不显示顶部工具栏
   - `renderContent`: 渲染 `FaceEditLayer`（预览图+生成结果缩略图）
   - `renderBottomBar`: 渲染 `FaceEditPromptBar`（Prompt输入+模型选择+参考图+生成按钮）
   - face-edit 模式跳过 `CanvasProvider`（不需要 Fabric.js 画布）

3. **`FloatingEditorPortal.tsx`** — 关闭时若当前模式为 `face-edit`，同时清理 `faceEditOpen` 状态。

### 新增文件

4. **`FaceEditLayer.tsx`** — 在节点上直接显示预览图和生成结果，底部有缩略图条，支持全屏查看，显示生成中状态。

5. **`FaceEditPromptBar.tsx`** — 水平布局的控制面板，定位在节点下方，包含 Prompt 输入、参考图上传、色彩工具、模型选择、比例选择、保存/添加到画布按钮、生成按钮。

### 兼容性处理

6. **`FaceEditOverlay.tsx`** — 当 `assetItem.nodeId` 存在时不再渲染（由浮动编辑器接管）。从 `AssetPanel` 打开的修容（无 nodeId）仍然使用旧的 Modal 浮层。

### 数据流

```
点击修容按钮 → openFaceEdit({src, title, nodeId})
  → 设置 faceEditOpen + faceEditAssetItem
  → 调用 openFloatingEditor(nodeId, "face-edit")
    → FloatingEditorPortal 渲染 EditorContainer
      → FaceEditLayer (节点上的预览)
      → FaceEditPromptBar (节点下方的控制面板)
```

## 修容面板嵌入主画布 — 实施完成

### 架构变更

**之前**：点击修容按钮 → `openFaceEdit()` → `FaceEditOverlay` (全屏 Modal Portal 覆盖主画布)

**现在**：点击修容按钮 → `openFaceEdit({ nodeId })` → `openFloatingEditor(nodeId, "face-edit")` → `FloatingEditorPortal` → `EditorContainer` → `FloatingPanel(overlayNode)` + `FaceEditLayer` + `FaceEditPromptBar`

### 修改的文件

1. **`media-space-store.ts`** — `openFaceEdit` 改为仅在有 `nodeId` 时委托给 `openFloatingEditor`，无 `nodeId` 时回退旧 overlay。`closeFaceEdit` 同步关闭浮动编辑器。

2. **`EditorContainer.tsx`** — 添加 face-edit 状态管理（从 store 读取 `faceEditGeneratedImages`，本地管理选中索引/生成状态/主体图片），三个 render 分支 (`renderTopBar` → null, `renderContent` → `FaceEditLayer`, `renderBottomBar` → `FaceEditPromptBar`)。`CanvasProvider` 在 face-edit 模式下被跳过（不需要 fabric canvas）。底部安全区增大到 160px 适配 PromptBar 高度。

3. **`MediaSpaceHolder.tsx`** — `FaceEditOverlay` 保留但标注为 deprecated，仅用于 AssetPanel 无 nodeId 的回退路径。

## 修改总结

### 架构变更
将修容功能从全屏 Modal 浮层（`FaceEditOverlay`）迁移到 FloatingEditor 系统，直接嵌入主画布上。

### 修改的文件

**1. `media-space-store.ts`** — Store 联动
- `closeFloatingEditor` 现在会在 `face-edit` 模式下自动重置 `faceEditOpen` 状态，确保关闭浮动编辑器时修容状态同步清理

**2. `EditorContainer.tsx`** — 添加 face-edit 路由
- `renderTopBar`: face-edit 不显示顶部工具栏（无 Fabric 画布操作）
- `renderContent`: face-edit 渲染 `FaceEditLayer`（预览图 + 缩略图条），传递 `width`/`height`/`selectedIndex`/`isGenerating`
- `renderBottomBar`: face-edit 渲染 `FaceEditPromptBar`（560px 宽），定位在节点下方 130px
- 外层 `EditorContainer`: face-edit 模式跳过 `CanvasProvider` 包裹（无需 Fabric 画布）

**3. `FaceEditPromptBar.tsx`** — 新组件
- 水平布局的控制面板，参考 `PromptBar` 的样式风格
- 包含：Prompt 输入框 + Subject 切换（Popover） + 参考图上传 + 色彩工具 + 模型选择 + 宽高比选择 + 生成按钮
- 从 `FaceEditControls` 提取完整的生成逻辑（包括 WAN 2.7 Pro 直连 DashScope API 和标准 `sendImageGeneration`）
- 通过 `onSelectedIndexChange` 和 `onGeneratingChange` 回调与 `FaceEditLayer` 共享显示状态

**4. `FaceEditOverlay.tsx`** — 防双重渲染
- 添加 `useFloatingEditor` 守卫：当浮动编辑器正在处理 face-edit 模式时，不渲染全屏 Overlay
- 保留了从 AssetPanel 打开修容（无 nodeId）的兼容性

### 未修改的文件（已确认无需改动）
- **`image-node-tools.tsx`**: `handleFaceContouring` 调用 `openFaceEdit`，内部已自动调用 `openFloatingEditor`
- **`FloatingEditorPortal.tsx`**: default 分支已覆盖 face-edit，路由到 `EditorContainer`
- **`MediaSpaceHolder.tsx`**: 保留 `FaceEditOverlay`（通过守卫条件仅在非画布场景显示）

### 数据流
```
点击修容 → openFaceEdit(nodeId) → openFloatingEditor("face-edit")
  → FloatingEditorPortal → EditorContainer
    → FaceEditLayer (预览/缩略图，overlayNode 布局)
    → FaceEditPromptBar (控制面板，节点下方)
```

## 修改总结

### 1. `media-space-store.ts` — Store 状态扩展

- 新增 `faceEditSelectedIndex: number` 状态字段，用于在 `FaceEditLayer`、`EditorContainer` 和 `FloatingEditorPortal` 之间共享当前选中的生成图索引
- 新增 `setFaceEditSelectedIndex` action
- `closeFaceEdit` 时自动重置 `faceEditSelectedIndex` 为 0
- 在 `useFaceEdit` selector 中导出 `selectedIndex`
- 在 `useFaceEditActions` selector 中导出 `setSelectedIndex`

### 2. `FloatingEditorPortal.tsx` — 退出时应用生成图到节点

- 在 `handleClose` 的 `face-edit` 分支中，通过 `useMediaSpaceStore.getState()` 读取当前选中的生成图 URL
- 如果有选中的生成图，使用 `updateNode` 将其写入节点的 `data.src`，这样退出修容后节点上显示的就是修改后的图片，不再回退原图

### 3. `FaceEditLayer.tsx` — 添加"添加到画布"按钮 + 放大陈列栏

- **"添加到画布"按钮**：在 hover 操作按钮组中新增一个 `Plus` 图标按钮，点击后调用 `createFactory` 创建新的上传图片节点并放到画布中心位置（逻辑与 `FaceEditOverlay.handleAddToCanvas` 一致）
- **放大陈列栏**：
  - 缩略图尺寸从 `w-12 h-12`（48px）放大到 `w-20 h-20`（80px）
  - 容器增加 `backdrop-blur-md` 背景模糊和更大的圆角 `rounded-xl`
  - 间距从 `gap-1.5` 增加到 `gap-2`，内边距也相应增大
  - 选中状态增加 `scale-105` 和 `ring-2` 使其更醒目

### 4. `EditorContainer.tsx` — 使用 Store 共享状态

- 将本地的 `useState(0)` 替换为从 store 读取的 `useFaceEdit().selectedIndex` 和 `useFaceEditActions().setSelectedIndex`，确保选中索引在组件间同步

 "plan": "# 缩略图悬停大图预览\n\n## 背景\n\n当前项目中有 4 处展示小缩略图的位置，均无悬停预览功能。用户希望鼠标停留在小图上时，能弹出一个更大的图片预览。\n\n## 方案\n\n利用项目已有的 `@tap/shadcn` 中的 Radix `Tooltip` 组件（自带 Portal 渲染），自定义 TooltipContent 展示图片而非文字。这样做的优势：\n- 自动处理定位和溢出（Portal 渲染到 body，不会被 Popover 容器裁剪）\n- 自带进入延迟、动画等 UX 细节\n- 代码量小，复用性好\n\n## 实现步骤\n\n### 1. 创建可复用的 `ImageHoverPreview` 组件\n\n在 [`packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/`](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/) 目录下新建 `ImageHoverPreview.tsx`。\n\n组件签名：\n\n``​`tsx\ninterface ImageHoverPreviewProps {\n  src: string;\n  alt?: string;\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n  side?: \"top\" | \"right\" | \"bottom\" | \"left\";\n  previewSize?: number; // 默认 200\n}\n``​`\n\n核心实现：用 `Tooltip` + `TooltipTrigger` + `TooltipContent` 包裹 children，TooltipContent 内渲染一个大图 `<img>`，自定义样式（透明背景、无默认 padding、圆角 + 阴影）。设置 `delayDuration={300}` 使预览响应更快。\n\n### 2. 在 4 处缩略图位置接入\n\n- **[FaceEditPromptBar.tsx](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/context/media-space/floating-editor/FaceEditPromptBar.tsx)** (行 411-415, 445-449, 480-484)：主体选择弹窗内的 `w-8 h-8` 缩略图，用 `ImageHoverPreview` 包裹每个 `<img>` 所在的 `<button>`，`side=\"right\"`\n\n- **[FaceEditControls.tsx](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditControls.tsx)** (行 366-370, 402-406, 442-446)：侧栏弹窗内的 `w-10 h-10` 缩略图，同样包裹，`side=\"left\"`（因为弹窗在左侧展开）\n\n- **[FaceEditPreview.tsx](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/components/face-edit/FaceEditPreview.tsx)** (行 165-207)：生成结果横向条的 `w-16 h-16` 缩略图，包裹每个缩略图 div，`side=\"top\"`\n\n- **[FaceEditLayer.tsx](fe-app-tapnow-main/packages/canvas/src/core/context/media-space/floating-editor/FaceEditLayer.tsx)** (行 171-222)：画布底部的 `w-20 h-20` 缩略图，包裹每个缩略图 div，`side=\"top\"`\n\n### 3. 注意事项\n\n- 需要在外层确保有 `TooltipProvider`。检查应用根是否已有，若无需添加。\n- Tooltip 在 Popover 内部使用时，Radix UI 的 Portal 机制能正确处理层级关系。\n- 预览图尺寸建议 200x200，使用 `object-cover` + `rounded-lg`，背景透明以适配深色主题。\n",

But looking at the pattern in the codebase, many components also add their own local `TooltipProvider`. For our `ImageHoverPreview` component, I should include a `TooltipProvider` locally to be safe and self-contained, like other components in the codebase do.


Now I'm building the `ImageHoverPreview` component with the tooltip wrapper and hover preview functionality.

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\face-editor\\fe-app-tapnow-main\\packages\\canvas\\src\\core\\components\\face-edit\\ImageHoverPreview.tsx",
 "contents": "import {\n  Tooltip,\n  TooltipContent,\n  TooltipProvider,\n  TooltipTrigger,\n} from \"@tap/shadcn\";\nimport { memo } from \"react\";\n\ninterface ImageHoverPreviewProps {\n  src: string;\n  alt?: string;\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n  side?: \"top\" | \"right\" | \"bottom\" | \"left\";\n  previewSize?: number;\n}\n\nexport const ImageHoverPreview = memo(\n  ({\n    src,\n    alt = \"Preview\",\n    children,\n    side = \"top\",\n    previewSize = 200,\n  }: ImageHoverPreviewProps) => {\n    return (\n      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>\n        <Tooltip>\n          <TooltipTrigger asChild>{children}</TooltipTrigger>\n          <TooltipContent\n            side={side}\n            sideOffset={8}\n            className=\"p-0 bg-transparent border-none shadow-none overflow-visible\"\n          >\n            <img\n              src={src}\n              alt={alt}\n              style={{ width: previewSize, height: previewSize }}\n              className=\"object-cover rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-border/50\"\n            />\n          </TooltipContent>\n        </Tooltip>\n      </TooltipProvider>\n    );\n  },\n);\n\nImageHoverPreview.displayName = \"ImageHoverPreview\";\n"
}
```
